title: The Quran — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Muslims believe the Quran is the literal word of God revealed to Muhammad over about twenty-three years, beginning in 610 CE. It is organized into 114 chapters, called surahs, and is recited in Arabic in worship worldwide. This overview edition presents The Quran within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
